root_cause: GitHub ubuntu-latest moved to Ubuntu 26.04 while the repo pinned Playwright @playwright/test 1.55.0. Production Portal V2 DOM Readback run 39216880329 failed at Chromium install with 'Playwright does not support chromium on ubuntu26.04-x64' before any DOM acceptance could run.
prevention_rule: Pin all seven affected Playwright 1.55 browser-proof jobs (including two direct screenshot workflows) to supported ubuntu-24.04; keep browser/visual checks required and assert runner compatibility through a machine-enforced CI regression.
